faq.question: Who is wovain for?
faq.answer: Independent designers and small labels who sell graphic pieces through print-on-demand: tees, sweatshirts, totes and prints on Fourthwall.

faq.question: Will it make my label look generic?
faq.answer: You set the direction and approve every piece. Reject a design with a note and wovain draws another round. Nothing is listed without your yes.

faq.question: Will wovain spend money on ads by itself?
faq.answer: No. Every campaign is created paused, at the daily budget you choose, from $1 to $500. Spend starts only when you turn it on in Meta Ads Manager.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: A Fourthwall shop for the products, a fal account for the artwork and a Meta ad account for the campaign. You connect each one with its own sign-in after you create your account.

faq.question: How are prices set?
faq.answer: From the blank's real base cost on Fourthwall: at least $10 profit and a 30% margin, after card fees, sales tax and a refund reserve, rounded up to a whole dollar. You can change any price later in Fourthwall.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: wovain's plans are on the pricing page. Production is paid from each sale through Fourthwall, artwork is billed by fal and ad spend by Meta, each to your own account.

faq.question: Can I use it in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Yes. wovain is also an app in ChatGPT, with the same steps and approvals. The docs explain how to add it.

faq.question: Who owns the designs?
faq.answer: You own your briefs and the designs you approve. wovain screens drafts for names and trademarks, but you stay responsible for what you publish.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We keep as little as we can, and we never sell data.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, email and password hash for your account; the briefs you write; and the runs, designs and products wovain makes for you.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use PostHog, hosted in the US, to learn how people find and use wovain: the pages you visit, what you click, page speed, the site's language and your country. Your country comes from your IP address, which isn't kept, and the page checks whether an automated browser is driving it, so bots aren't counted as visitors. Until you accept, it runs without cookies or browser storage, so it can't recognize you across visits or record replays. If you accept, or where the law doesn't require asking first, it stores an ID in your browser and records session replays, with everything you type and your account details hidden. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings at the bottom of the page, and a Global Privacy Control signal from your browser counts as a no. Once you sign in, these events are tied to your account's id, never your email.
privacy.connectionsBody: When you connect Fourthwall, Meta or fal, we store the access they grant so wovain can act for you. You can disconnect any of them at any time from Connections.
privacy.processorsBody: Briefs and designs are sent to the services that do the work: Nebius, Qloo, Tavily, fal, Fourthwall and Meta. Each handles data under its own policy.
privacy.deleteBody: Email privacy@wovain.com from your account's address and we delete your account, runs and stored connections within 30 days.

credit.question: What is a credit?
credit.answer: A credit pays for one unit of wovain's work. Trend research takes 3, a design takes 2, and ad copy or an autopilot call takes 1, so a drop you approve step by step is about 6 credits. If a step fails, its credits come back.

yours.question: What do I pay outside wovain?
yours.answer: Art, ads and products run on your own accounts. fal bills you for the artwork, Meta bills your ad account once you start a campaign, and Fourthwall takes the blank's cost out of each sale.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, any time, from Manage billing. Your plan and its credits stay until the end of the month you paid for, then you're back on Free.

rollover.question: Do unused credits roll over?
rollover.answer: On Free, credits refresh each month and unused ones don't carry over. When Label opens, its unused credits will roll over, and credit packs won't expire.

free.question: What happens when I run out?
free.answer: wovain stops before the step and tells you. Your {freeCredits, number} free credits come back next month, and nothing you made is lost. Paid plans and packs of {packCredits, number} credits are coming soon.

paid.question: When can I buy Studio, Label or credits?
paid.answer: Soon. For now every account is on Free. Press Notify me on the plan you want, so we know which one to open first.
